newsitem.title: USA: Harnishfeger begins Gildings & Lewis tender.
newsitem.headline: Harnishfeger begins Gildings & Lewis tender.

text.p: Harnischfeger Industries Inc said Monday it was beginning a previously announced all-cash tender offer for all shares of Giddings & Lewis Inc at a price of $19 per share.

The $747 million offer, including debt, was announced Friday. Harnischfeger said tender offer materials are being filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and will be sent to holders of G & L shares.
The tender offer and withdrawal rights will expire at midnight on May 23, unless extended.

Gildings & Lewis has recommended its shareholders wait on the offer until its board reviews the offer and said the value of its shares is not fairly reflected in the marketplace. Gildings & Lewis shares closed at 13-5/8 Friday.

Harnischfeger is an international holding company with business segments involved in the manufacture and distribution of equipment for underground mining, surface mining, pulp and papermaking, and material handling.
